verdict.rationale: Dagster ships an extensively documented Python API (`dagster as dg`) and `dg` CLI for defining/scaffolding pipelines, plus a Dagster+ MCP server explicitly built to 'access information and take actions in your Dagster+ deployment within an AI session,' and a maintained AI 'skill' giving coding agents context for building Dagster projects — all of which let an AI-native user drive the product programmatically. However, a probe for a standard REST/OpenAPI spec returned 404s across all candidate endpoints, so there's no evidence of a conventional public REST API, only Python SDK/CLI/MCP surfaces. Missing for 10: a documented REST/OpenAPI or GraphQL API spec, and independent/hands-on confirmation that AI agents successfully drive Dagster end-to-end via these interfaces.
